title: SCP-906, Scouring Hive
description: A man-shaped mass of worms… and when it breaks apart, the swarm begins.
body:
Scouring Hive adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-906, also known as Scouring Hive.


SCP-906 is a humanoid entity composed entirely of writhing worms. With high health, damage, and a trail of corrosive particles left in its wake, SCP-906 is a slow but relentless threat. When attacked or killed, it can break apart into swarms of worms that continue to attack its target. SCP-906 inflicts the Corrosion effect. At close range, it may spit a mass of worms that explodes into living entities on impact. Defeating it is risky, as the entity disintegrates into worms upon death. The worms themselves can even be collected with a bottle, but drinking them is always fatal.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-906 spawn?

SCP-906 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-906.

</details>



![SCP-906](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/448970fd1c51beb89c5a2ea08aba95298e4a7037.png)

SCP-906 appears as a humanoid creature made out of worms. It moves slowly but leaves behind trails of worm particles and corrosive residue. Its attacks deal heavy damage and apply the Corrosion effect. When injured with a player nearby, SCP-906 has a 50% chance to spawn a worm. At death, it collapses entirely, scattering into nine worms if a player is present. At close range, SCP-906 may also spit a ball made out of worms that bursts and spawns additional worms on impact. Its true danger is not just its size, but the endless swarm it carries within.
